points.description: States that every dimension of the multi-dimensional array must be specified except the first one. Equivalent wording earns the mark, e.g. 'all dimensions apart from the first', or 'only the first dimension can be left empty/omitted, the rest must be given'. Naming only the first dimension as the one that is not needed is sufficient. Answers that say all dimensions, or that name a different dimension, earn no mark.

rubric.notes: The model answer is a single idea, so this is one all-or-nothing point worth the full 5 marks. Full marks require the student to state that every dimension except the first must be given, in any equivalent wording. Any answer that says all dimensions are required, or that names a different dimension, gets no marks.
